name: log-analyzer-lua
description: Analyzes application logs for errors, warnings, and performance metrics (Lua implementation)

tools.name: analyze_logs_lua
tools.description: Parse log lines and extract error counts, warning counts, and average response times

log_lines.description: Array of log line strings to analyze

executor.source:
function analyze_logs_lua(args)
    local log_lines = args.log_lines or {}
    
    local error_count = 0
    local warning_count = 0
    local info_count = 0
    local response_times = {}
    
    for _, line in ipairs(log_lines) do
        local line_lower = string.lower(line)
        
        if string.find(line_lower, 'error') or string.find(line_lower, 'exception') then
            error_count = error_count + 1
        elseif string.find(line_lower, 'warn') then
            warning_count = warning_count + 1
        elseif string.find(line_lower, 'info') then
            info_count = info_count + 1
        end
        
        local rt = string.match(line, 'response_time=(%d+)ms')
        if rt then
            table.insert(response_times, tonumber(rt))
        end
    end
    
    local avg_rt = 0
    local max_rt = 0
    if #response_times > 0 then
        local sum = 0
        for _, t in ipairs(response_times) do
            sum = sum + t
            if t > max_rt then max_rt = t end
        end
        avg_rt = sum / #response_times
    end
    
    return {
        total_lines = #log_lines,
        error_count = error_count,
        warning_count = warning_count,
        info_count = info_count,
        avg_response_time_ms = math.floor(avg_rt * 100) / 100,
        slowest_request_ms = max_rt
    }
end
